content.rendered:
We are looking forward to welcoming you all to our STEM Night from 5:00-7:00 on Thursday, February 29. Food will be provided from 5:00-6:00 in the cafeteria and activities will be available throughout the building. We wanted to expand our focus to include the other three elements of STEM, beyond just math as in past years. 

This year, you and your students will find math activities with their teachers, science and technology activities in the STEM lab, as well as engineering and technology in the commons area. In addition, we have invited Sherwood middle and high school courses and local community partners to showcase some of their offerings. We hope you can join us for this fun-filled event!

*Please note: This is not a drop off event. We expect students to be with their families as there will be a lot of expensive and breakable equipment around the building. Thank you for your cooperation with this.
